FIELDS.NAME: Active Lifestyle Club
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Facility Manager, 123 Active Way, Springfield, IL 62704, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@activelifestyle.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Active Lifestyle Club is a premier recreation facility dedicated to promoting health and wellness within our community. We operate a variety of moderate-risk activities, including golf, swimming, tennis, and bowling, within our facility. The club prioritizes the safety and satisfaction of our members by maintaining comprehensive security measures, such as controlled access and surveillance systems.

To ensure a safe and enjoyable environment, our operations are supported by a documented maintenance program and staff training protocols focused on safety, emergency response, and customer service. We emphasize compliance with local health and safety regulations and have established strict controls for any associated food and beverage services, ensuring our staff are trained and adhere to all applicable laws.

In addition to our core activities, we are actively involved in community engagement through well-supervised programs catering to families and various age groups, fostering a positive atmosphere. Our financial management practices assure stability, allowing us to continue providing quality recreational services while managing potential risks associated with offered activities.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/15/2022, Cause: Slip and fall accident in the gym area due to a wet floor, Amount: $1,500.00, Status: Closed. Loss Date: 03/10/2023, Cause: Minor property damage from a maintenance issue with a leaking pipe, Amount: $1,000.00, Status: Closed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Comprehensive security system with fencing and regular patrols by trained watchpersons.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The facility manager is responsible for checking these certificates to ensure compliance.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – The Active Lifestyle Club has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance history has been steady and compliant with industry standards.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Active Lifestyle Club does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all staff are directly employed by the club. This arrangement allows us to maintain consistent training and operational protocols.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – The Active Lifestyle Club carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect both the employees and the business.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – The Active Lifestyle Club also operates the Active Lifestyle Fitness Center, which focuses on health and fitness activities. Both businesses aim to promote wellness within the community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Active Lifestyle Club does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The current policy is sufficient for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Active Lifestyle Club is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing recreational activities and services to our members.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Active Lifestyle Club does not rent or loan equipment to others, as we focus on providing recreational activities exclusively for our members within our facility.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, indicating stable financial management.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Active Lifestyle Club does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on moderate-risk recreational activities in a safe environment. We maintain strict safety protocols to ensure the well-being of our members and staff.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Active Lifestyle Club does not have any known catastrophe exposure as our operations are conducted in a safe environment, focusing on moderate-risk activities without any significant risks associated with catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – The Active Lifestyle Club has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to a safe and respectful environment is a top priority.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Active Lifestyle Club has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all safety regulations within the facility.
